# Cook County Tax Compare

Cook County Tax Compare helps Cook County, Illinois residential property owners compare property assessments, understand appeal timing, and request optional property tax appeal help.

## Key Pages

- Homepage: https://cookcountytaxcompare.com/
- Property tax comparison tool: https://cookcountytaxcompare.com/property-tax
- Cook County property tax appeal help: https://cookcountytaxcompare.com/cook-county-property-tax-appeal.html
- About: https://cookcountytaxcompare.com/about-cook-county-tax-compare.html
- Contact: https://cookcountytaxcompare.com/#contact

## What The Site Is Best For

- Comparing a Cook County residential property assessment with nearby properties.
- Looking up Cook County property appeal timing and official filing resources.
- Tracking personal appeal requests after login.
- Requesting optional flat-fee residential appeal help.

## Data And Methodology Summary

The site is built around public Cook County property and assessment data. It uses property address and PIN records to help homeowners find nearby assessment information and decide whether an appeal may be worth reviewing. Final property data, deadlines, and filing requirements should be verified with official Cook County sources.

## Important Notes

- Filing a property tax appeal directly with Cook County is free.
- Optional assisted appeal help is offered for a flat $99.
- Cook County Tax Compare does not guarantee a lower assessment, tax savings, refund, or successful appeal.
- Users should verify deadlines, property data, and filing requirements with official Cook County sources.
